label: FP
reason: User input is passed to doSomething(), which uses a conditional assignment to assign either "This_should_always_happen" or param to bar. The condition (7*18) + num > 200 evaluates to 126 + 106 = 232 > 200, which is always true, so bar is set to "This_should_always_happen" rather than the user input. Thus, the user-controlled value never reaches the HTML output sink.

evidence.note: Conditional assignment in doSomething sets bar to constant due to always-true guard
